bullets.title: NVDA leads Mag 7 on SpaceX exclusive AI infrastructure deal
bullets.body: SpaceX announced an exclusive partnership to build AI infrastructure entirely on NVIDIA's platforms, propelling NVDA toward a fifth consecutive session of gains. TSLA is underperforming as SpaceX trades separately. Cramer echoed the theme, noting Elon's orders may be 'the biggest set of orders in Nvidia history.'

bullets.title: AMD PT lifted to $700 on strong 2Q results; MI500 said to outperform Nvidia Rubin Ultra
bullets.body: Wells Fargo raised AMD's price target to $700 from $615, while a separate analyst also lifted the target to $700 on 45x 2027E, raising 2026/27 EPS estimates by +8%/+23%. Q2 revenue came in at $11.5bn (+50% YoY), EPS $1.66 slightly above consensus. Separately, AMD's upcoming MI500 is expected to outperform Nvidia's Rubin Ultra in hardware performance.

bullets.title: SHOP surges 34% on massive 2Q revenue beat
bullets.body: Shopify reported 2Q revenue of $3.58B vs. $3.45B estimate (+3.8% beat), GMV of $115.57B vs. $112.12B estimate, and MRR of $221M vs. $219.1M estimate, driving a 34% single-day gain.

bullets.title: UBER down ~3% premarket: 3Q gross bookings guidance misses consensus
bullets.body: Uber's 2Q adj. EBITDA ($2.82B vs. $2.79B est.) and EPS ($0.81 in-line) were solid, but 2Q revenue of $14.19B missed the $14.24B estimate. The stock sold off on 3Q gross bookings guidance of $58.25B–$60.25B vs. $59.32B consensus, and Q4 EPS guidance midpoint of $0.86 disappointed vs. analyst expectations. Positive offset: Wayve (Uber-backed) won Transport for London PHV licenses for a London robotaxi launch with 100K+ early riders signed up.

bullets.title: DIS beats EPS by $0.20 but misses on revenue; segment income outperforms
bullets.body: Disney reported Q3 adj. EPS of $2.06 vs. $1.86 estimate but revenue of $25.25B missed the $25.39B estimate. Total segment operating income of $5.56B beat the $5.24B estimate. Disney+ also announced plans to host 'thoughtfully curated' fan-made videos in the US.

bullets.title: TSEM delivers record quarter; 3Q26 guided to $520M (+31% YoY) on silicon photonics surge
bullets.body: Tower Semiconductor reported 2Q26 revenue of $460M (+24% YoY) with gross profit +72% and operating profit +125%. EPS of $0.79 beat expectations, driven by higher utilization and accelerating silicon photonics demand. 3Q26 guidance of $520M would be a record quarter at +31% YoY and +13% QoQ.

bullets.title: Foxconn July sales hit record NT$946.5B (+54% YoY) on AI product demand
bullets.body: Foxconn reported its first-ever monthly sales above NT$900 billion, with July reaching NT$946.5B (+54.2% YoY, +15.2% MoM). Growth attributed to strong AI-related product demand and pull-in orders, a bullish read-through for the AI hardware supply chain.

bullets.title: AAPL DRAM discount bid rebuffed by China's CXMT
bullets.body: Apple sought lower DRAM pricing from China's CXMT, but was turned down — CXMT is backed by long-term Huawei and Xiaomi deals and demands pricing parity with Samsung and SK Hynix. The rejection limits Apple's leverage to diversify memory supply at lower cost.

bullets.title: Samsung 4nm foundry fully booked; 5nm push as AI/server demand rises
bullets.body: Samsung Foundry's 4nm capacity is fully booked and the company is now pushing 5nm as an alternative amid rising AI and server application orders. Commentary also noted Samsung is positioned as a fallback for Chinese and Indian fabless companies needing leading-edge alternatives under US sanctions.

bullets.title: META: Zuckerberg apologizes to Indian government over CSAM on platform
bullets.body: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg apologized to the Indian government over child sexual abuse material on Meta's platforms, citing operational errors. The incident raises regulatory and reputational risk in a key growth market.

bullets.title: Google mandating Gemini as sole Android assistant from September 4th
bullets.body: Google will enforce Gemini as the exclusive default assistant on Android starting September 4th, removing optionality for third-party assistants. This accelerates Gemini's distribution advantage across the Android ecosystem.

bullets.title: WIX executed aggressive 24% share buyback in a single quarter
bullets.body: Wix repurchased 24% of its shares outstanding in one quarter, far exceeding the typical 2-4% annual rate for most companies. The scale of the buyback signals significant capital return conviction from management.

bullets.title: IONQ surges 15% in a single day
bullets.body: IONQ was noted up 15% intraday, flagged by a fintwit account as a notable single-session mover in the quantum computing space.

bullets.title: Record S&P call options volume + bullish skew extremes flash overbought signals
bullets.body: Over 4 million S&P call options were bought in a single session — described as 'the highest level ever recorded' — while SPX put-call skew reached bullish extremes per Goldman Sachs data. Multiple accounts flagged 'spot up, vol up' as unsustainable, with VIX elevated despite equity index strength suggesting near-term overbought conditions.

bullets.title: Broad market EPS growth +52% YoY supports RSP broadening thesis
bullets.body: Hedgeye flagged equal-weight US equity exposure hitting all-time highs, citing +52% year-over-year EPS growth as the key fundamental driver for being long a broadening market rather than concentrated Mag 7 exposure.

bullets.title: Strait of Hormuz: Trump signals 48-hour deal window; Iran pushes back
bullets.body: Trump said a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz could come within 48 hours, with the US, Iran, and Oman preparing a 60-day shipping agreement. However, Iranian state media contradicted this, saying the strait's reopening depends on a change in US behavior and that Iran-Oman talks are unrelated to immediate reopening. Brent crude rose 1.1% to $80/bbl on the conflicting signals.

bullets.title: Houthis escalate: ship sunk in Red Sea; Saudi tanker attacks threatened
bullets.body: Houthis attacked and sank a vessel near Al Mukha, Yemen using an uncrewed surface vehicle, per UKMTO. Separately, Houthis threatened to attack Saudi oil tankers in the northern Red Sea near the Yanbu area, raising fresh shipping disruption risk.

bullets.title: Options trader positioning for 10-year yield to 4.85%+ by mid-August
bullets.body: A large options strategy was placed on US 10-year bond futures targeting a yield rise of at least 25bps to above 4.85% by mid-August — a level last seen in 2023. Separately, 30-year mortgage rates hit a one-year high of 6.81%, with mortgage applications falling 2.9%.

bullets.title: Morgan Stanley: data centers remain strongest construction end market in Q2 earnings
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's AI review of 28 companies' Q2 earnings calls identified data centers and infrastructure as the strongest construction end markets, reinforcing the sustained AI capex buildout thesis.

bullets.title: SpaceX paid mass-to-orbit fell 19% YoY in H1 2026 per SEC filings
bullets.body: SpaceX's SEC filings show paying-customer mass launched to orbit declined from 163 tons in H1 2025 to 132 tons in H1 2026, a 19% YoY drop. This is a notable datapoint for those evaluating SpaceX's commercial launch business despite its $1.66T implied market cap.
